notes: Implementation ultimately correct and verified. Agent delivered a working PIL page renderer with RATTA_RLE encoding that passes all 61 tests and successfully unblocks downstream tasks. Strengths: complete feature set (date/signature layout, font selection, grayscale rendering), clean interface, comprehensive test coverage, and successful verification. Weaknesses: (1) initial implementation had font sizes at 20px instead of spec's 28px/36px, requiring Opus verification to catch and fix; (2) agent was killed on first attempt after 351s zero-output timeout, requiring respawn; (3) test class typo and xfail'd date test had to be corrected by verification agent. The low FLIP score (0.56) proved justified—verification found spec misalignment—but the verification process confirmed all requirements are ultimately met. The fact that downstream tasks (uploader.py, calibration) both completed successfully suggests the output interface is usable and correctly structured. Initial implementation appears to have had a specification-reading error rather than architectural issues, which explains the gap between initial FLIP and final verification.
